result.title: HumanSkill-4D: Training-Free Language Querying of Animatable Gaussian Avatars in Space and Time
result.comment: 29 pages, 14 figures, 16 tables. Project page: https://jjunsss.github.io/HumanSkill-4D/
result.summary: We introduce avatar referring segmentation, which selects regions of animatable Gaussian avatars from language queries. A query can also specify a pose or motion to select matching intervals. This lets users interact with avatars for local editing and motion inspection. However, making these selections with existing language Gaussian splatting methods poses two challenges: adjacent parts and garments are hard to separate and may be referred to indirectly (region ambiguity), while fine-grained motions can look alike in RGB (motion ambiguity). We address these challenges with HumanSkill-4D, a training-free framework that shares a multimodal large language model (MLLM) and geometric operators across avatars. For each avatar, a semantic memory links body-part and garment categories to persistent Gaussian regions and appearance descriptions. The MLLM uses category names and descriptions to select categories by appearance, relation, or function. To find matching intervals, it composes operators into programs that check query conditions on driving joint trajectories stored in a motion memory. These category choices and operator outputs make selections traceable, while composing or adding operators supports new motion conditions. To evaluate this task, we introduce three human-annotated benchmarks and show that HumanSkill-4D outperforms the baselines in part segmentation and 3D and 4D referring segmentation, with compact memories and only minutes of setup per avatar.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 HumanSkill-4D，一个无需训练、跨 avatar 共享 MLLM 与几何算子的框架：用语义记忆把身体部位与衣物类别绑定到持久高斯区域，再由 MLLM 组合算子程序，按语言查询在空间和时间上选出可动画高斯 avatar 的对应部位或动作区间，并给出三个标注基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 「MLLM 组合可核查算子程序 + 分区语义记忆」形成显式、可追溯的中间决策与证据筛选路径，可能作为 LVR 中监督信号、贡献分配与显式-隐式推理对照的可核查线索；但对象是 4D avatar 分割，与视觉 latent 推理联系较远。
